cards.ex: He had to pull strings to get his son into that school.
cards.exUz: U o'g'lini u maktabga kiritish uchun ta'sir o'tkazishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining aloqalari orqali kimga yordam berish yoki biror narsaga erishish.

cards.ex: As the CEO, she gets to call the shots around here.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor sifatida u bu yerda barcha qarorlarni qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha qarorlarni qabul qilish, vaziyatni nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: Everyone should have a say in how the project is run.
cards.exUz: Loyiha qanday boshqarilishi haqida har kim o'z fikrini bildirish huquqiga ega bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror qarorni qabul qilishda o'z fikrini bildirish huquqiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: His opinion carries a lot of weight with the board of directors.
cards.exUz: Uning fikri direktorlar kengashi uchun juda katta ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Fikri, so'zi boshqalar uchun muhim va ta'sirli bo'lish.

cards.ex: She keeps all her employees under her thumb.
cards.exUz: U barcha xodimlarini qattiq nazorat ostida ushlab turadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir qattiq nazorati ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The merger was seen as a power play by the larger company.
cards.exUz: Qo'shilish yirik kompaniya tomonidan hokimiyat o'yini sifatida qaraldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir hokimiyatga erishish yoki uni mustahkamlash uchun qilingan harakati.

cards.ex: Tradition still holds sway in many rural communities.
cards.exUz: An'ana hali ham ko'plab qishloq jamoalarida hukmronlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir fikri, g'oyasi katta ta'sirga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's been throwing his weight around ever since he got promoted.
cards.exUz: U lavozimga ko'tarilganidan beri kuch ishlatmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z kuchini, hokimiyatini ko'rsatishga urinish, boshqalarni qo'rqitish.

cards.ex: Now that she's the manager, she's in the driver's seat.
cards.exUz: Endi u menejer bo'lgani uchun u vaziyatni boshqaradi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni boshqarish, nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: With her at the helm, the company is sure to succeed.
cards.exUz: U boshqaruvda bo'lgani uchun kompaniya muvaffaqiyatga erishadi.
cards.uzDef: Tashkilot yoki loyihaning boshqaruvida bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's slowly gaining influence within the organization.
cards.exUz: U asta-sekin tashkilot ichida ta'sirga erishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga ta'sir o'tkazish qobiliyatini oshirish.

cards.ex: The party is losing ground in the polls.
cards.exUz: Partiya so'rovlarda pozitsiyasini yo'qotmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ta'sir, kuch yoki nufuzni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: He's known as a power broker in the state legislature.
cards.exUz: U shtat qonun chiqaruvchi organida ta'sir o'tkazuvchi sifatida tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Katta ta'sirga ega bo'lgan, siyosiy o'yinlarda qatnashadigan shaxs.

cards.ex: The government is trying to exert more control over the media.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ommaviy axborot vositalari ustidan ko'proq nazorat o'rnatishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yoki odamlar ustidan nazorat o'rnatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The media plays a big role in shaping public opinion.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari jamoatchilik fikrini shakllantirishda katta rol o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning fikrini o'zgartirishga, yo'naltirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He tried to bend everyone to his will.
cards.exUz: U hamma odamlarni o'z xohishiga bo'ysundirishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir o'z xohishiga bo'ysundirish.

cards.ex: She always finds a way to get her way.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z maqsadiga yetish yo'lini topadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xohishiga erishish, o'zi xohlaganidek bo'lish.

cards.ex: He has a lot of clout in the industry.
cards.exUz: Uning sanoatda katta ta'siri bor.
cards.uzDef: Katta ta'sir kuchi, nufuz.

cards.ex: Right now, they hold all the cards in the negotiation.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi paytda ularning muzokaralarda barcha imkoniyatlari bor.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni nazorat qilish, muhim imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's a force to be reckoned with in the political arena.
cards.exUz: U siyosiy maydonda hisoblashadigan kuch.
cards.term: a force to be reckoned with
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy qabul qilinadigan, e'tiborga loyiq kuch.

cards.ex: He wields a lot of power within the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniya ichida katta hokimiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatdan foydalanish, uni qo'llash.

cards.ex: She's determined to climb the corporate ladder.
cards.exUz: U korporativ zinapoyadan yuqorilashga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Lavozimda ko'tarilish, martaba pog'onalaridan o'tish.

cards.ex: The president is doing everything he can to stay in power.
cards.exUz: Prezident hokimiyatda qolish uchun qo'lidan kelganicha harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatni saqlab qolish, uni yo'qotmaslik.

cards.ex: The military coup was seen as a power grab.
cards.exUz: Harbiy to'ntarish hokimiyatni egallash sifatida baholandi.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatni zo'rlik bilan yoki noqonuniy yo'llar bilan egallash.

cards.ex: The company bowed to public pressure and changed its policy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya jamoatchilik bosimiga taslim bo'lib, o'z siyosatini o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Bosim ostida o'z fikridan voz kechish, boshqalarning xohishiga ko'nish.

cards.ex: They have leverage in the negotiations because they control the supply.
cards.exUz: Ularning muzokaralarda ta'sir o'tkazish imkoniyatlari bor, chunki ular ta'minotni nazorat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror vaziyatda ta'sir o'tkazish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's a rising star in the world of finance.
cards.exUz: U moliya olamida yuksalayotgan yulduz.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada muvaffaqiyatga erishishi kutilayotgan odam.

cards.ex: He's known for making waves with his controversial opinions.
cards.exUz: U munozarali fikrlari bilan to'lqin yaratishi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: O'z harakatlari bilan boshqalarda e'tiroz, norozilik uyg'otish.

cards.ex: He needs to get a grip and stop panicking.
cards.exUz: U o'zini tutishi va vahima qilishni to'xtatishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zini nazorat qilish, xotirjam bo'lish.

cards.ex: Whoever pays the piper calls the tune.
cards.exUz: Kim pul to'lasa, o'sha buyruq beradi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni nazorat qilish, boshqalarga nima qilishni aytish.
